description: The file compiles on the build server against anchor-lang 1.1.2
Compiles ⇒ VaultState has owner: Pubkey, balance: u64 and bump: u8 — INIT_SPACE is 41
Compiles ⇒ #[account] and #[derive(InitSpace)] are both present: an 8-byte discriminator plus INIT_SPACE
Compiles ⇒ deposit and withdraw take (&mut self, u64) and return Result<()>
Compiles ⇒ VaultError is an #[error_code] enum carrying Overflow, InsufficientFunds, ZeroAmount and NotOwner
